cut.v04-la-com-die: Cut for the cap: a good room on the Place de la Comédie, but the Lons lane keeps the town's soul table (Ô Tablier), the poularde-au-Vin-Jaune house (La Petite Auberge) and the bouchon with the grill (Les Marronniers).
cut.v07-la-table-de-perraud: Cut for the cap: a reliable traditional table; its pochouse is named in The Dish, and the Lons lane keeps three tables with more to teach.

v-maison-jeunet.name: Maison Jeunet par Steven Naessens
v-maison-jeunet.address: Château de Germigney, 31 rue Edgar Faure, 39600 Port-Lesney
v-maison-jeunet.verdict: The Arbois two-star of Jean-Paul Jeunet, carried by his successor Steven Naessens to the Château de Germigney at Port-Lesney in November 2021: Morbier and Morteau cromesquis, snails in Savagnin broth, Bresse poultry with Vin Jaune and morels.
v-maison-jeunet.signature: Bresse poultry with Vin Jaune and morels.

v-fromagerie-vagne.name: Fromagerie Vagne
v-fromagerie-vagne.verdict: The fromager-affineur under the arcades: Comté at several ages side by side, Bleu de Gex, Morbier, Mont d'Or in season and cancoillotte.
v-fromagerie-vagne.signature: Comté at three ages, cut side by side.
v-fromagerie-vagne._source: old gastronomy, dish and avoid cards
